speaker: Doctor
text: Given the biopsy findings of cellular atypia and the patient's significant smoking history, these lesions are highly consistent with squamous cell carcinoma in situ, also known as Bowen's disease. The presence of similar lesions on both the penis and finger suggests a field effect from chronic tobacco exposure or potential HPV involvement, though the histology points toward malignancy. DIAGNOSIS READY: Bowen's disease (Squamous Cell Carcinoma in situ)
